A super easy and delicious twist on the classic bhurji, made with besan and the most basic ingredients you already have at home. It comes together in no time and is perfect for breakfast, lunch, or even a quick dinner.
Enjoy it with some bread slices or laccha paratha, and don’t forget the ketchup, it goes surprisingly well with this bhurji! The full written recipe is mentioned below in the description. Do give it a try. Happy Cooking!
